review_notes: All 50 images visually reviewed in local EXIF-transposed contact sheets. Boxes enclose the visible vertical fin with a small margin; horizontal stabilizers, fuselage and background are excluded where a rectangular box permits. Existing occlusions and edge truncation are retained, not reconstructed.

Alaska 1-4 retain legacy faces; 10 retains the standard face within the Kraken special livery. Delta 9-10 retain their T-tail junctions. Southwest 1-5 retain modern unlettered fins, 6-10 older lettered/retro fins. United retains both gold and blue globe liveries.

Shared photographer alone is not proof of a shared session. Conservative session groups use source titles, nearby photo identifiers and visual context. Registrations in SOURCES.md are distinct unless explicitly grouped by session.

Southwest 1-5 have no recorded attribution. Visual review shows different angles/backgrounds/airframes and no matching photograph; each is provisionally independent, with provenance uncertainty retained here and in copied SOURCES.md.
